newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor falls on speculative offerings.
newsitem.headline: India castor falls on speculative offerings.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery initially rose by 3/4 rupees at 1,147 rupees per quintal on limited inflow but later slid to 1,143/1,144 rupees per quintal on renewed speculative offerings on Wednesday, dealers said.
Arrivals in Gujarat dropped to 6,000/7,000 bags (75 kg each) from the 10,000/12,000 bags recorded on Tuesday.
"Arrivals in Gujarat fell today due to a strike called by political parties," one operator said.
Groundnut oil rose from 367/368 rupees to 370 rupees per 10 kg amid limited inflow and shortage of ready stock.

In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 580/585 rupees per 15 kg. In Bombay imported palm-oil rose by 1/2 rupees at 263 rupees per 10 kg on the back of uptrend in the world market and absence of fresh arrivals at Bombay port.
